Price alerts now understand the way you actually say them, typed or spoken:

- "Tell me when gold goes about 4000" now sets an alert for gold above 4,000. Speech often hears "above" as "about", "a bow" or "ever", and "below" as "blow", "bilo" or "bellow"; "goal" or "gol" for "gold"; "four thousand", "for thousand", "4k", "₹4,000" and "4 000" for 4000. Friday now reads all of these.
- Over, crosses above, more than, ">" and similar words mean above; under, drops to, falls to, less than and "<" mean below.
- With no direction ("tell me when gold hits 4000"), Friday compares the target with Sona's latest saved price and sets above or below to match, then says what it set: "Alert set: gold above 4,000 (now 3,962). Checking every 5 min." If Sona has no recent price yet, the alert fires when gold reaches the target from either side.
- Friday no longer answers "No alert was created" when you name gold and a price. If it is only guessing a word, it asks "Did you mean: alert when gold goes above 4,000?" with Yes and Edit buttons. It only asks what to watch when no asset was named.
- Voice: Friday listens in Indian English by default (Settings > Voice input language to change it), gives the recognizer its command words as hints, and when the recognizer offers several guesses it picks the one that reads as a command. Tap your own message in the chat to edit and resend it.

Built on v1.0.165 with all of its changes kept. Trading is unchanged. Signed with the same key, so it installs over v1.0.165 with no uninstall. Checked by CI tests, not yet on a phone.
